paragraphs: R' Shimon bar Hiyya of Huzah taught Hiyya bar Rav: Jerusalem Avodah Zarah, chapter 4. Rav Yoshiyah said to him. R' Laya bar Yehudah reports in his name: Jerusalem Shabbat, end of Ba-Meh Behemah, and Ba-Meh Ishah, end of halakhah 1.
